node.statement: The exact registered compressed-product-display asserts ||X dot Y-XY||<=O(e)||X||||Y|| only for the level-one map S_{P,Q} x S_{Q,R} -> S_{P,R}. None of the permitted definitions, node 1.1.1, lem-hcb0-compressed-associator, or lem-hcb1-column-action identifies its entrywise amplification with Co_{I_n tensor P,I_n tensor R}, or otherwise bounds that amplification uniformly in n. The epsilon-Banach-Cstar product axiom controls the ambient amplified product AB once A dot B is known to be the appropriate compression, but it does not supply the missing compression identity or its uniform error estimate.
